MonoPaint 0.98.1 is tested on Supernote firmware 3.30.45 and fixes the Masking fluid dot in landscape.

- **Supernote firmware 3.30.45 is tested on both the Manta and the Nomad.**
  MonoPaint no longer says the firmware is untested at startup, and Settings
  shows it as tested.
- **In landscape, the Masking fluid button shows its dot again** while it's
  selected.

New in 0.98: Watercolor mode with a wet canvas and blow dryer, masking fluid,
the wet brush pen's dipped ink, quick page actions, two- and three-finger
undo and redo, and paintings that save themselves. See the
[0.98 release notes](https://github.com/mpdairy/monopaint/releases/tag/v0.98).

Download **monopaint.apk** and follow the [sideload instructions](https://github.com/mpdairy/monopaint#sideload-onto-a-manta).
Update with `adb install -r monopaint.apk` to keep your paintings and settings.
